categories.name: KYC Suspension & OTP Harvesting
categories.explanation: Scammers claim your account or SIM card will be blocked immediately unless you update KYC or share a verification OTP.
categories.what_to_do: Never share OTP or banking passwords with anyone over the phone or SMS. Real banks never ask for OTP.

categories.name: UPI Collect Request & Fake Cashback
categories.explanation: Fraudsters send collect payment requests disguised as cashback or refunds, asking you to enter your UPI PIN to 'receive' money.
categories.what_to_do: Remember: You NEVER enter your UPI PIN to receive money. PIN is strictly required only when sending money.

categories.name: Digital Arrest & Law Enforcement Impersonation
categories.explanation: Impostors pose as police, CBI, or customs officials claiming you are under 'digital arrest' for illegal parcels or money laundering.
categories.what_to_do: There is no such legal procedure as 'digital arrest'. Law enforcement never conducts trials or demands deposits over video calls. Hang up immediately.

categories.name: Courier Seizure & Customs Penalty
categories.explanation: Scammers claim an overseas parcel sent in your name was seized containing contraband (drugs, passports), demanding clearance penalties.
categories.what_to_do: Do not send money or verify personal details. Legitimate postal and customs agencies issue formal written notices, never demands by phone.

categories.name: Work From Home & Task/Review Scam
categories.explanation: Offers enticing pay for simple tasks like liking videos, then traps victims in VIP prepaid deposit cycles.
categories.what_to_do: Legitimate employers never demand advance security deposits or task fees. Cease communication and do not transfer funds.

categories.name: Tech Support & Remote Access Tool Impersonation
categories.explanation: Fake popups or callers claim your system has critical viruses and instruct you to install remote access tools like AnyDesk.
categories.what_to_do: Never install remote desktop tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) at the request of an unverified caller. It gives them complete control over your device.

categories.name: Bank Impersonation & Card Security Trap
categories.explanation: Scammers pose as bank representatives reporting fraudulent card activity to trick you into revealing CVV, card numbers, or ATM PINs.
categories.what_to_do: Banks will never ask for your card CVV or ATM PIN. Call your bank using the trusted number printed on the back of your card.

categories.name: Gift Card & Crypto Payment Pressure
categories.explanation: Callers demand emergency settlement using gift card voucher codes or crypto kiosks, which cannot be refunded or traced.
categories.what_to_do: No official company, utility, or government entity accepts gift cards or cryptocurrency as payment. This is always a scam.

categories.name: Lottery & Lucky Draw Prize Fraud
categories.explanation: Claims you won a massive lottery or game show prize, requiring advance processing or tax payments to release the money.
categories.what_to_do: If you did not enter a lottery, you did not win. You never have to pay money to claim a legitimate prize.

categories.name: Romance & Guaranteed Investment Scheme
categories.explanation: Builds trust over social platforms before introducing fraudulent high-yield investment websites or fake customs fees for romantic gifts.
categories.what_to_do: Never invest in unknown platforms recommended by online acquaintances. High guaranteed returns are a hallmark of Ponzi fraud.

categories.name: Fake Tax / GST Refund
categories.explanation: Scammers pose as the tax department promising a refund so you click a link and enter bank or card details.
categories.what_to_do: Tax refunds are only processed through the official income tax e-filing portal; never claim them through an SMS link.
